create_mirror_module: create a MirrorModule instance with a Motion, mirror axis, correction vector, and optional bone overrides
get_bone_transformations: get mirrored bone transformations for specified frame and bone indices with optional correction applied
detect_symmetry: detect left-right bone symmetry from joint names using common naming conventions like _l_ _r_ or Left Right
draw_skeleton: draw the mirrored skeleton visualization in the editor using AI4Animation Draw Skeleton
get_module_name: get the name string Mirror from the MirrorModule instance
